title: Jonah and the Terminal Again
author: Elodie Thackeray
blurb: Rafael Montrose, a clone who inherited the original's murder case, records the slow death of a colony everyone else forgot. Then the colony's children start sharing the same dream — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now she must keep a lie alive that holds two fleets apart, and time is already running out.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
